title: Distributed calibration probe and drift resilience for FP8 on Hopper (E4M3/E5M2)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Purpose: Safely enable FP8 quantization profiles (E4M3 and E5M2) on Hopper GPUs by building a distributed calibration probe that detects model- and workload-specific drift, instruments per-op scaling adjustments, and wires conservative fallback and rollback triggers into the serving runtime. This ticket focuses on the orchestration and validation scaffolding (probe harness, telemetry thresholds, canary gating) rather than the per-model quant parameters. Goals: 1) Run a reproducible, low-cost calibration probe that samples representative shards across traffic dimensions. 2) Surface drift/residual errors per-op and per-layer to prioritize calibration adjustments. 3) Define clear canary pass/fail metrics and automated fallback behavior when drift exceeds tolerances. 4) Integrate with existing CI/telemetry pipelines and provide runbook for on-call.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration probe can be executed as a K8s job across n=5 shard-samples and produces deterministic per-op scaling suggestions within 12 hours
Telemetry dashboard shows per-layer delta distributions and a scalar 'FP8 stability score' that maps to canary gates
Canary rollout automation will automatically demote routes to INT8 or float variants when stability score falls below configured threshold
Playbook created and validated with on-call during a scheduled drill; rollback completes within 90s for affected shards
tasks: Design distributed probe runner and sampling strategy (stratified by seq_len, request_shape, model_family)
Implement per-op residual collector in runtime (low-overhead hooks to export histograms)
Add scoring lambda that aggregates residuals into an FP8 stability score and percentile metrics
Wire probe results to console telemetry with a dedicated FP8 calibration dashboard
Create canary automation: gating rules, alert thresholds, and automatic route fallback
Run smoke suite against 6 representative models (decoder-only and encoder-decoder) and record accuracy deltas
Author runbook and SRE drill steps for fallback and post-mortem
